name: ComfyUI MiniMax H3 Turbo
tagline: Run MiniMax-H3 video with synchronized audio in as few as 4 sampling steps
description: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo brings the MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA to ComfyUI, letting you generate joint video plus synchronized audio in as few as 4 sampling steps instead of ~20. Two nodes drop straight into the official H3 workflow — a Turbo LoRA node and a Turbo Sampler node that feeds SamplerCustomAdvanced. The recommended v4 checkpoint (600 steps) fixes the over-sharpening of earlier v1 builds, with a static-frame enhancement; 6-8 steps remove the only remaining trade-off for large fast motion.
highlights: Joint video + synchronized audio in as few as 4 sampling steps
Two nodes that drop straight into the official H3 workflow
Turbo LoRA applied directly to the model
v4 checkpoint with static-frame enhancement and fixed over-sharpening
Apache-2.0, from the MiniMax H3 ecosystem
curatorNote: Dropping H3 from ~20 steps to 4 while keeping synchronized audio is a huge practical win for iteration speed. Clean node design that slots straight into the official workflow.
